exam: 107年公務人員高等考試一級暨二級考試
subject: 英文

essays.text:
英譯中：
①Vaccine opposition has ebbed and flowed over centuries. In themid-1800s, people protested in the streets of England after the Britishgovernment began requiring citizens to get the vaccination. Manyopponents mistrusted doctors and were wary of a medical treatment theydidn’t understand. For a long time in history, people treated theseopponents as irrational and anti-progress — kind of a lunatic fringe. Butthere were good reasons to be leery of vaccines. In the early days, theclosely related cowpox virus was used to immunize people againstsmallpox.（25 分）
②We need to reject any politics that targets people because of race orreligion. This isn’t a matter of political correctness. It is a matter ofunderstanding what makes us strong. The world respects us not just forour arsenal; it respects us for our diversity and our openness and the waywe respect every faith.（15 分）
中譯英：（20 分）反對線上教育的人主張，在教與學整個過程中，建立師生連結扮演重要的角色，而面對面的互動則是建立這樣連結的關鍵要素。要是教師沒有實際在場，學生難以釐清某些特定科目的複雜內容。

英文作文：（40 分）Over the past decade, gap years have become popular among young people.Gappers who have just graduated from college believe that to take one yearoff before entering the “working world” would help boost their personal andprofessional development. Is taking a gap year after college a good idea?Write an English essay of about 300 words to explain why you support ordiscourage the gap year.
